18.75% (Quad) |rewards = {{Exp|0}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''PVP Test''' was a recurring test mode prior to the release of the [[PVP]] mode. The enemies in '''PVP Test''' were based on various modes based on player rank, though instead of the goal of surviving to the final wave, players were meant to defeat their opponent by sending enemies at them. If the final wave was beaten, it would repeat indefinitely until one team loses. Wins did not count as triumphs (except for [[Quests]]), but losing this mode counted as a loss. This mode could be played in Casual, which had no added restrictions, and in Ranked, where players from a team could ban up to two towers. This mode had three rank based difficulties. The first one is Low Rank, which was based around [[Casual Mode|Casual]] mode, the second was Mid Rank, which was based on [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] and [[Molten Mode|Molten]] modes and the third was High Rank, that was based on [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. Which one was started is based on the the player's rank. The player's rank goes up and down with triumphs and loses in Ranked matches. '''PVP Test''' applied multiple restrictions to players. The most noticeable change was the player loadout being reduced to four players. Additionally, all exclusive categories and golden perks were prohibited. Another large change was consumables, as this mode only allowed '''PVP Test''' exclusive ones. Every 8 seconds, players received cash from an economy bonus. The economy bonus could be seen under the tower placement limit. It could be increased by sending enemies to the opponent. Each send increased it by its own value and {{Money|20}} was added to the bonus after each wave. Cash was only obtained if an enemy was killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gotten was a set amount of cash, which was not always equal to the enemy's health. In solo, the player received 100% of the cash when an enemy was killed or damaged enough. With each additional player, this decreased by 25%, which meant that in a quad, any specific player would only get up to 25% of the cash. This amount was distributed between players based on how much damage they dealt. However, if a player did not deal any damage, they would receive a percentage of the enemy's full cash upon its death or when it was damaged enough, which is 12.5% in duo, 16.7% in trio and 18.75% in quad. If it was a decimal, it got rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it was at least 0.5, it got rounded up. If it was less than 0.5, it got rounded down. For example, the [[Hidden Boss]] gave {{Money|600}} when killed in solo, {{Money|450}} in duo, {{Money|300}} in trio and {{Money|150}} in quad between the players that damaged it. Players that did not damage it received {{Money|75}} in duo, {{Money|100}} in trio and {{Money|113}} in quad. ==Rewards== '''PVP Test''' did not grant any rewards or badges upon completion. ==Trivia== *It was possible to infinitely delay Wave 7 and Wave 16 by sending enemies, due to the waves not ending until all enemies, including summoned ones, disappeared from the map. *In the first '''PVP Test''', the [[Tank]] could be seen in the send menu, but could not be sent because it was only available starting from Wave 26, while the first '''PVP Test''' only had 25 waves. *Red Team has an inherent advantage against Blue Team as it has less priority, meaning Blue always gets its base health deducted first if two enemies were to enter both bases simultaneously. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''18 May 2024''' -
